sentences.en: What can cheer up, soften, color everything - a big love.
sentences.zh: 1. 什么能振奋精神、使一切变得温和、增添色彩——那就是伟大的爱。

sentences.en: You can soften dialysis tubing by soaking it in water.
sentences.zh: 2. 可以通过浸泡在水中来软化透析管。

sentences.en: Knead the clay like bread to soften it before sculpting.
sentences.zh: 3. 在雕塑之前像揉面包一样把泥土揉一揉，使其变柔软。

senses.zh: 使温和；使缓和；使变柔软
